# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified, timing-feasible incumbent at 194 LUTs and 95 FFs, with WNS 0.076 ns and WHS 0.096 ns. Iteration 2 was rejected because it used 195 LUTs, so the conditional add/subtract rewrite is not the next experiment. The supplied seed retains iteration 1’s registered outputs; the top’s numeric latency is unknown, so no numeric annotation is required.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the extended add-two rounding expressions with explicit 16-bit conditional increments may reduce LUT use while preserving the registered output timing and values.

## Instruction for generator
In `cordic_engine`, replace the `x_next_rounded`, `y_next_rounded`, and `x0_rounded` 19-bit add-two paths with 16-bit results formed by incrementing bits `[17:2]` when the corresponding bit `[1]` is set. Preserve the existing output-register reset, acceptance-edge initialization, busy-edge updates, and hold behavior exactly. Keep the CORDIC coordinate add/subtract logic unchanged, and retain all simulation, routed timing, metric-integrity, and promotion gates.
